visualisationsList.name: AWS S2 NDVI
visualisationsList.description: Amazon Web Services Sentinel 2 NDVI: The normalized difference vegetation index, abbreviated NDVI, is defined as (NIR-RED)/(NIR+RED)

visualisationsList.name: AWS S2 Coastal (B01)
visualisationsList.description:
Amazon Web Services Sentinel 2 Coastal: 433 - 453 nm.
Strong water penetration; high atmospheric Rayleigh scattering. Shallow bathymetry, aerosol retrieval, atmospheric correction

visualisationsList.name: AWS S2 Red Edge 1 (B05)
visualisationsList.description:
Amazon Web Services Sentinel 2 Vegetation Red Edge 1: 698 - 713 nm.
Marks the sharp onset of the red-edge slope. Extremely sensitive to subtle chlorophyll variations. Early crop stress and disease detection. Nitrogen and chlorophyll content estimation. Crop growth stage monitoring.

visualisationsList.name: AWS S2 Red Edge 2 (B06)
visualisationsList.description:
Amazon Web Services Sentinel 2 Vegetation Red Edge 2: 733 - 748 nm.
Mid-point of the red-edge transition curve. Reflectance correlates strongly with canopy volume. Leaf Area Index (LAI) calculation. Canopy chlorophyll content retrieval. Biomass estimation.

visualisationsList.name: AWS S2 Red Edge 3 (B07)
visualisationsList.description:
Amazon Web Services Sentinel 2 Vegetation Red Edge 1: 773 - 793 nm.
Upper plateau of the red edge transitioning into NIR. Resilient against background soil noise. Advanced biophysical parameters (LAI, FAPAR). Forest canopy structure analysis. Crop yield forecasting.

visualisationsList.name: AWS S2 Red Edge 4 (B08A)
visualisationsList.description:
Amazon Web Services Sentinel 2 Red Edge 4: 855 - 875 nm.
Narrow band avoiding water vapor absorption features. Pure radiometric NIR response. Atmospheric correction validation. Biophysical modeling and spectral unmixing. Forest type and species discrimination.

visualisationsList.name: AWS S2 NIR (B08)
visualisationsList.description:
Amazon Web Services Sentinel 2 Near Infra Red: 785 - 900 nm.
Highest native resolution NIR band. Intense internal leaf scattering (mesophyll). Total absorption by clear water. High-resolution vegetation indices (NDVI). Surface water and coastline delineation. Plant vigor and biomass assessment.

visualisationsList.name: AWS S2 Water Vapor (B09)
visualisationsList.description:
Amazon Web Services Sentinel 2 Water Vapor: 935 - 955 nm.
Positioned precisely within a prominent atmospheric water vapor absorption band. Estimating total atmospheric water vapor column. Input for radiative transfer models and atmospheric correction (Sen2Cor).

visualisationsList.name: AWS S2 Cirrus (B10)
visualisationsList.description:
Amazon Web Services Sentinel 2 Cirrus: 1360 - 1390 nm.
Complete atmospheric absorption by tropospheric water vapor (ground is invisible. Only high ice clouds reflect signal. High-altitude cirrus cloud detection.

visualisationsList.name: AWS S2 SWIR 1.6 (B11)
visualisationsList.description:
Amazon Web Services Sentinel 2 Short-Wave Infrared 1.6: 1565 - 1655 nm.
Strong absorption by liquid water in leaf tissues and soil. High contrast between snow and cloud. Canopy water content & moisture stress (NDWI/NDII). Soil moisture estimation. Cloud vs. snow/ice separation. Penetrating smoke and haze.

visualisationsList.name: AWS S2 SWIR 2.2 (B12)
visualisationsList.description:
Amazon Web Services Sentinel 2 Short-Wave Infrared 2.2: 2100 - 2280 nm.
Highly responsive to hydroxyl-bearing minerals, clay, and carbonate rocks. Sensitive to high thermal hotspots. Normalized Burn Ratio (NBR) & burn severity. Active wildfire and hotspot tracking. Mineralogical, lithological, and geological mapping.
